verdict.rationale: BVNK explicitly states wallet creation/management can be done via either the Portal or the API (bvnk-docs-4, bvnk-docs-25), and the API surface covers payments, payouts, transfers, rules and embedded wallets extensively, suggesting broad functional parity. However there is no explicit statement that *all* UI capabilities (e.g. rewards, virtual cards, partner markup config) are equally exposed via API, and no independent confirmation of full parity. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement covering non-wallet features, and third-party/community confirmation that UI-only features don't exist.
